run_make_datasets: run the make_datasets script to generate GLIGEN training annotations from COCO images
create_ram_model: create a RAM model for image captioning with swin-l backbone and 384px input resolution
build_grounding_dino_detector: build a grounding-dino zero-shot object detector to find bounding boxes from text prompts
generate_blip2_captions: generate BLIP-2 captions for cropped image regions given bounding box coordinates
compute_clip_embeddings: compute CLIP text embeddings for captions with max-length tokenization and truncation
